messages:
kira: Kicking off telemetry for apac1-gpu cluster bring-up — want to land logs/metrics/traces + a minimal dashboard + alert templates before handoff. Quick checklist idea below, input welcome.

sam: +1. can we keep retention/cost controls tight? APAC egress/storage costs spiky.

david: Agree. Proposal: 30d metrics, 7d logs by default for new clusters, optional longer for specific namespaces. Also sample traces 10% by default.

kira: plan: (1) prometheus + prometheus-operator + node-exporter + nvidia-smi-exporter for gpu metrics, (2) loki for pod logs, (3) tempo for traces, (4) grafana org+dashboard templates, (5) alerting rules bundle + runbook links.

maria: A few gotchas from last time: need kubelet opts to expose container GPU metrics (DCGM/Exporter) and set up nccl exporter for training infra. Also mount /var/log/pods to Loki.

infra-bot: terraform apply started: plan id tf-apac1-telemetry-20260314-01. Track: https://infra.internal/tf/plans/tf-apac1-telemetry-20260314-01 :gear:

sam: For alerts — let's include: GPU_Utilization > 90% for 5m, GPU_Memory_Usage > 92% for 5m, Node_Disk_Byte_Usage > 85%, Pod_OOM_kube_events, Eviction_Rate spike. Add a cost alert if Loki monthly bytes > budget threshold.

david: Adding suggested prometheusRule example (quick paste):

```yaml
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: PrometheusRule
metadata:
  name: redwood-gpu-alerts
spec:
  groups:
  - name: gpu.rules
    rules:
    - alert: HighGPUUtilization
      expr: avg by(node) (nvidia_gpu_utilization{job="nvidia-smi"}) > 0.9
      for: 5m
      labels:
        severity: page
      annotations:
        summary: "GPU utilization >90% on {{ $labels.node }}"
```

maria: For Loki, use index dedup and gzip chunk encoding. retention policy via object storage lifecycle (7d) + hot store size cap. We'll add a quota per-namespace using promtail relabeling and Loki tenant limits.

oncall: who is owning the oncall rotation post-handoff? we need to add to schedule and include runbooks in alerts.

kira: i'll own initial oncall for two weeks plus runbook handoff to platform oncall. putting pages in pagerduty 'telemetry-apac1' and adding runbook link.

grafana-bot: grafana: created org 'apac1-telemetry', folder 'gpu-cluster'. Dashboards uploaded: GPU Overview (id 402), Pod Health (id 403).

sam: dashboard notes — include heatmap for GPU memory fragmentation, tensor-core saturation counters, and per-namespace cost breakdown panel (estimated tokens->GB mapping for logs).

david: validation checklist before handoff:
- Prometheus scrape targets healthy (>=95%)
- GPU exporter metrics present for >90% of nodes
- Loki pushing logs from kube-system and training namespaces
- Tempo traces sampling events visible in Grafana
- Alert rules firing in test mode (we simulate high GPU util)
- Dashboard panels load < 2s for default time range
- Cost dashboard shows projected monthly estimate < budget or flagged

kira: performed smoke tests: simulated high GPU util on slice-02 node, alert fired to test channel, PD escalation test passed :white_check_mark:. Loki log ingestion sustained 120MB/min during bootstrap test, retention estimate ~2.7TB/month if left unbounded -> we are enforcing 7d default retention.

maria: handoff notes added to wiki: https://wiki.internal/redwood/telemetry/apac1-bootstrap (contains terraform IDs, helm values, sample alert rules, and runbooks).

sam: one more: set autoscale thresholds for prometheus/thanos/tempo to avoid CPU throttle on ingestion spikes; use verticalPodAutoscaler for prometheus-server.

kira: tagging this thread with action items: 1) finalize alert annotations + runbook links (owner: maria), 2) finalize retention & billing caps in terraform (owner: sam), 3) schedule platform oncall handoff (owner: kira). I'll update thread once PD schedule created.

oncall: noted. please @oncall in alert templates so PD routing works.

infra-bot: terraform apply complete. resources: prometheus, loki, tempo, grafana, s3-bucket telemetry-apac1-logs. plan: https://infra.internal/tf/runs/12345

kira: thanks everyone — next step: formal handoff session tomorrow 09:30 APAC protect. agenda: demo dashboards, alert playbook, cost model, TL;DR troubleshooting.

sam: I'll bring the cost projection slides.

david: I'll run through the validation checklist live.

maria: adding a small script to rotate grafana API keys post-handoff.

kira: closing thread for now, will reopen with handoff notes. :rotating_light:
